setup_august.title: Connect your August account in Home Assistant
setup_august.description: August Local uses the official August integration for sign-in, verification and token refresh. [Add August to Home Assistant](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start?domain=august), finish signing in there, then return here and press Submit to check again. If August is already configured, finish any reauthentication and make sure it is loaded. No password is collected by August Local.

account_source.title: Choose your connected August account
account_source.description: Select an account already signed in through Home Assistant’s official August integration. August Local uses that session to retrieve an installed Bluetooth key; it does not save a separate account token. To use another account, add it to the official August integration first. Factory registration, calibration and keypad pairing are not implemented.

connect.title: Connect {name} locally
connect.description: Keep your Bluetooth proxy near the lock and close the August app. Continue to verify its installed key and configure local HA access. This does not move the deadbolt.

error.no_loaded_august_account: No signed-in August account is loaded yet. Complete setup or reauthentication in Home Assistant’s official August integration, then try again here.
error.invalid_selection: Select an available account or lock from the list.
error.no_offline_key: This account has no installed offline key for the selected lock. Factory setup and new key provisioning are not supported by this wizard.
error.bluetooth_connection_failed: The lock could not be reached over Bluetooth. Keep the proxy near the lock and the August app closed, then retry.
error.bluetooth_auth_failed: The installed Bluetooth key was rejected. Refresh the provisioned key through the official August integration; this is separate from account sign-in.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Door PINs is already configured. Use Configure to reconnect its lock.
abort.no_account_locks: The connected August account returned no owner-accessible locks. Check the selected official August account. Factory registration is not supported here.
abort.bluetooth_setup_failed: Home Assistant’s Bluetooth setup could not finish. Check Yale Access Bluetooth.
abort.different_lock: Reconnect the same lock selected for Door PINs.
abort.invalid_auth: The official August session was rejected. Complete reauthentication in Home Assistant’s August integration, then restart this setup. This is not a Bluetooth failure.
abort.account_connection_failed: Home Assistant could not reach August’s account service. Check the official August integration and network connection.
abort.account_response_changed: The official August account session or response could not be read by this version. Check compatibility and sanitized HA logs; credentials are withheld.
abort.account_service_error: The connected August account request failed. Check the official August integration and sanitized HA logs.
abort.account_endpoint_unavailable: August’s account endpoint is unavailable. Check the official August integration.
abort.invalid_account_request: August rejected a request made through the connected official account. Check the official August integration and sanitized HA logs.
abort.rate_limited: August is rate-limiting account requests. Wait before retrying.
